desc: Enhance your shooting experience with the all-new True Precision P365 Flat Trigger, designed for the Sig P365, P365XL, and any other P365 model. Cut from billet steel with chamfered edges, this trigger features a better-than-OEM angle and lip for an improved fit and feel. Its easy-to-install drop-in design and matched coatings with all other True Precision products make this the best upgrade for any Sig P365. Get yours today!
